name: SA Veneri-11
about: SA Veneri-11 (1978-084C, IKI/BABTS), launched 1978 Sep  9. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Venus. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Venus on GCAT's date); its perihelion 0.712 au and aphelion 1.045 au against GCAT's 0.700 and 1.100
